1. Color list semantics differ per chart type. For Bar, Histogram, StackedBar, Radar and Pie the color list is PER DATA POINT / CATEGORY (list size must equal the number of points, or validation fails with "Colors size N does not match expected M"). For Line (including multi-series) and StackedArea the color list is PER SERIES (list size must equal the number of series/items). Omitting the color list falls back to a single color and skips the validation.

2. The chart title and legend are rendered by the library from MaterialTheme.colorScheme and their TextStyle is not exposed through ChartViewDefaults - they cannot be fully themed without an upstream change.
3. The canvas is a fixed 256dp tall, 360dp wide block (chart view = card token, dashed-free), set through modifierChart in the view style.
